history.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克的SpaceXAI在密西西比州AI数据中心发生化学品泄漏
history.descriptionZh:
美国密西西比州南黑文市一处SpaceXAI设施发生化学品泄漏，密西西比州环境质量局（MDEQ）已介入。确认泄漏物为5,000至6,000加仑（约1.9万至2.27万升）的丙二醇。丙二醇是一种传热流体，也常用于防冻液等产品。泄漏物最终流入一条排水沟，但MDEQ根据当地媒体报道告知居民，目前没有直接的健康或安全威胁。相关部门同时确认，将继续采集水样送实验室进一步分析，工作人员则继续清理区域并监测是否还有后续问题。报道说，化学品被控制在排水沟内，未进入附近的Horn Lake Creek。

这起事件并非芯片或AI模型技术突破，而是AI数据中心基础设施在冷却、供电和环保合规方面面临的新一轮审视。丙二醇作为传热流体，常用于需要温控和冷却的系统和产品中；此次泄漏让数据中心周边社区的环保风险再次受到关注。对南黑文的SpaceXAI而言，11月并不顺利。本月早些时候，该公司在一起涉及当地污染的诉讼中遭遇挫折。报道提到一桩2026年4月的诉讼，针对该公司用于为大孟菲斯地区设施供电的燃气电厂，称其安装了27台燃气轮机但未取得所需许可，并指该电厂每年可能排放超过5,000吨氮氧化物和47吨甲醛，甲醛属于致癌化学品。公司曾试图把这些涡轮机归类为移动设备以规避许可问题，但法官驳回了这一做法。

面对当地对其存在的敏感情绪，SpaceXAI曾向两座孟菲斯数据中心附近居民提供Starlink五折优惠，并免除349美元硬件费用。报道说，从6月底到9月初，大孟菲斯和南黑文地区约有2,000名居民注册了Starlink连接服务。此外，孟菲斯市最近宣布，将根据新的《社区福利条例》进行首笔重大投资，该基金使用SpaceXAI的Colossus 1设施收入，近330万美元将回流该市，用于住房和社区改善。整体来看，这一事件反映出AI数据中心在快速扩张中，除了算力和芯片，还越来越需要应对冷却液泄漏、燃气发电排放、许可合规和社区关系等现实问题。

history.title: The Downfall of Jensen Huang — a timeline of allegations and scandals that brought down the king of AI infrastructure
history.description: Jensen’s affairs dominated headlines, but the seeds of his downfall were planted in both the bedroom and the boardroom and stretched from Beijing to Washington, with Nvidia sitting right in the middle.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia rose from a niche gaming hardware company with an unofficial motto of "Our company is thirty days from going out of business” to becoming the world’s most valuable company by market capitalization in 2024, and co-founder and chief executive Jensen Huang was the man behind its meteoric rise.He planned and founded the company in 1993 alongside Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem while sitting inside a Denny’s diner in the Silicon Valley area. After more than 30 years, Nvidia had thousands of employees, a global footprint, and a name that people equated to AI chips.All this came crumbling down for the billionaire founder in a matter of weeks, but the cracks started long before the first accusation. Let’s go back and see how it all began. This is an ongoing saga, so we have listed stories related to the scandal below, which we will update as events unfold.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The end of an era Jensen resigned from Nvidia on November 12, after two weeks of news reports accusing him of multiple affairs, one with an alleged Chinese spy and another with his own subordinate. This is significant for Nvidia, which has had a single CEO since its inception. Huang was the face of the company, and many of its employees, shareholders, partners, and fans still support him despite the circumstances of his departure. He steered Nvidia into the giant that it is today by having the vision to develop CUDA nearly 20 years before ChatGPT made AI accessible to the average user and buying companies that helped it scale deployments to hundreds of thousands of AI GPUs.Jensanity (Image credit: YC Kuo/Facebook)By 2022, ChatGPT’s arrival and subsequent boom set the AI race in motion, with tech giants and AI startups buying up as many GPUs as they could get their hands on. The increased demand for Nvidia’s products caused it to break the trillion-dollar mark in less than a year after the release of OpenAI’s LLM. As the largest individual shareholders of the company, Huang and his wife, Lori, became some of the wealthiest people in the world. You may like How Shanghai fund manager Kang Wei introduced his wife Alice Huang to Jensen and built $7.5 billion Nvidia AI GPU smuggling operation US intelligence believes Jensen Huang had affair with Chinese spy in honeypot operation Alice Huang reportedly instrumental in securing over $7.5 billion of Nvidia AI GPU imports during three-year relationship with Jensen Huang The billionaire founder hasn't always gloated about his position. He once said in a podcast that if he could turn back time, he wouldn’t have founded Nvidia at all, and also cringed at the praises that the Caltech Board of Trustees chairperson heaped on him before he gave the 2024 keynote speech at the institute’s commencement exercises. He has frequently cited his history working as a “Dishwasher, Busboy, Waiter” at Denny’s, noting it under his experience on his LinkedIn page. More than that, people have seen Jensen go where other celebrity CEOs are rarely seen — enjoying street food in Vietnam, dining at a local fried chicken joint in Korea, and even dragging along 35 of Taiwan’s semiconductor CEOs to a restaurant in Taipei.But even as he’s building his “Man of the People” persona, his position as the head of arguably the most important chipmaker in the AI industry meant that he was also gaining influence in business and governance. Industry leaders noticed the power that Nvidia held over those who want GPUs to train their AI models, with some of his fellow billionaires begging him over dinner to sell them GPUs. Just weeks into President Donald Trump’s second term, Jensen Huang was meeting with him at the White House, discussing AI policy and hardware export controls — something the Biden administration started in 2022 in an attempt to hold back China’s ambition'sin AI.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsThe China problem The rivalry between the U.S. and China has been simmering for years, with Chinese companies like Huawei getting blacklisted because of their work with the People’s Liberation Army. In August 2022, about three months before ChatGPT made AI a household term, Washington expanded its trade bans on Beijing and imposed export controls on Nvidia’s H100 and A100 GPUs. The company responded to this by building a new data center GPU that conformed to U.S. standards specifically for the Chinese market, called the A800, by November of that year. Despite delivering only 70% of the performance of the A100 it was based on, the GPU reportedly still saw great demand from Chinese customers.However, the A800 only had a relatively short run as the Biden administration once again increased the performance threshold in October 2023, which resulted in the export prohibition of A800 and H800 GPUs to China. This move forced the company to iterate once again, creating new models that it could sell to Chinese companies, like the Nvidia H20. These chips arrived on the market in early 2024, but before the Biden administration ended in January 2025, it proposed even stricter rules called the AI Diffusion Policy. This sorted nations into different tiers based on trust and risk levels — countries in tier 1, which includes the U.S. and its closest allies, have minimal restrictions, while those in tier 3 are effectively barred from receiving advanced AI GPUs containing U.S. technology.This is problematic for Nvidia, as China is the second-largest computer market in the world t and represented between 20% and 25% of Nvidia's data center sales. The company lobbied the U.S. government to ease AI GPU export restrictions, with Trump reportedly suspending the proposed Nvidia H20 ban after Jensen spent $1 million to have dinner with the president in early April 2025. The White House went ahead anyway and banned the sale of the AI GPU less than a week after that, resulting in a $5.5 billion write-off for the company. What to read next Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns in the wake of multiple affairs, Chinese spy allegations Suspected Chinese spy at center of Jensen Huang affair surfaces in Beijing Nvidia’s Board reportedly preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang as second extra-marital affair emerges Jensen Huang himself had harsh comments about Washington’s trade ban, saying that “export control was a failure,” and that it had caused the company’s AI GPU market share in China to go from 95% to zero. He even argued that “conceding an entire market the size of China probably does not make a lot of strategic sense, so I think that has already largely backfired.”But even as Huang was fighting to have the trade ban on the Nvidia H20 chip lifted, he continued praising Trump’s tariff plan, calling it “utterly visionary.” The president eventually reversed the ban three months later, and by December 2025, he had approved Nvidia H200 exports to China, but only if Nvidia pays a 25% fee. The newer Blackwell and Vera Rubin chips remain out of reach for Chinese companies, though — at least on paper.“There’s no evidence of any AI chip diversion” (Image credit: Stanford Online/YouTube)Allegations that Chinese companies have been breaking Washington’s trade ban and smuggling Nvidia AI GPUs into China have been circulating since June 2023, after Reuters revealed that vendors in Shenzhen could secure A100 chips when asked discreetly. They reportedly bought these chips from the excess stocks sold in the open market or through intermediaries in India, Taiwan, and Singapore. Another story published in January 2024 asserted that the Chinese military and related institutions, state-run data centers, and even universities continue buying banned A100 and H100 chips. Six months after that, accounts of underground networks dedicated to smuggling AI GPUs — even entire servers — through other countries started emerging.In 2025, an investigative report showed that at least a billion dollars’ worth of Nvidia AI chips were allegedly funneled into China. Some sellers likened the illicit AI GPU trade to a seafood market, with brokers and retailers openly advertising the most advanced Nvidia AI chips online, from RTX 5090 GPUs to complete B200 servers.Even with all these reports, Huang continued denying that Nvidia’s chips were being smuggled into China. “There’s no evidence of any AI chip diversion,” the then-CEO told reporters at Computex 2025. He also added, “The Grace Blackwell system is nearly two tons, and so you’re not going to be shipping — you’re not going to be putting that in your pocket or your backpack anytime soon. And so, these systems are fairly easy to keep track of... but the important thing is that the countries and the companies that we sell to recognize that diversion is not allowed, and everybody would like to continue to buy Nvidia technology, and so they very well monitor themselves very carefully and they’re quite careful about that.”In the midst of all these AI chip smuggling rumors, the Bureau of Industry and Security, the agency in charge of enforcing U.S. trade sanctions, was found to be “inadequate” and underfunded, and it has been relying on outdated manual processes to enforce restrictions on Chinese tech companies. Despite that, companies and individuals across the world are being investigated and arrested for bypassing Washington’s export controls.Singaporean authorities broke up a smuggling ring in early 2025 that smuggled Nvidia GPUs for Chinese AI lab DeepSeek, resulting in a raid of 22 different locations and the arrest of nine people. In October of the same year, a Singapore company called Megaspeed, which was led by Alice Huang, allegedly diverted $2 billion worth of Nvidia chips. Four Americans were then arrested the following month for shipping 400 Nvidia A100s and attempting to send 50 more Nvidia H200 GPUs to China. Super Micro employees allegedly switching serial numbers between servers. (Image credit: US DOJ)An even bigger smuggling scandal unfolded some four months after the arrests, after three Super Micro employees were arrested for smuggling $2.5 billion of Nvidia hardware into China. The suspects included company co-founder Yih-Shyan “Wally” Liaw, although Super Micro itself was not implicated. The Super Micro case spanned the globe, with Taiwanese authorities raiding 12 locations related to the case in May 2026, with another nine sites and six people investigated in June. Jensen Huang urged the company to fix its export control compliance after the arrests and raids, telling the media, “We insist our partners are compliant. We hope that they will enhance and improve their regulatory compliance and prevent that from happening in the future.”But just five months after he made this statement, one stunning accusation unraveled it all.Scandal eruptsOn October 29, 2026, The New York Times published a report that Jensen Huang may have been the target of a Chinese spy plot through the executive of a firm who was “close” to him — that executive is Alice Huang. Nvidia denied the accusation. “Megaspeed has been no different than many other regional cloud customers. Jensen’s interactions with Ms. Huang are not unusual or unexpected. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO's job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year,” a company spokesperson told Tom's Hardware. “Our regional cloud customers receive ordinary business information — not sensitive NVIDIA trade secrets — and zero information relevant to national security."But a little over a week later, U.S. intelligence sources claimed that the former Nvidia chief had an affair with the Megaspeed executive. This is the same Megaspeed that has been accused of smuggling Nvidia chips to the tune of $2 billion. By the evening of Sunday, November 8, Jensen admitted to the affair, although he did not name the third party in his statement.Many government officials would usually turn a blind eye towards a tech executive’s personal life, but the fact that he is the leader of the U.S.’s premier AI chip maker and that he is also close to the president has caught the attention of authorities. This has led to the U.S. Congress asking him to a closed-door meeting to discuss Nvidia’s “security protocols against foreign adversary espionage” and the FBI investigating his relationship with the alleged Chinese spy.The admission and allegations led to people digging deeper into Alice Huang. An investigation by The Information revealed that she was connected to a “labyrinth” of companies spanning Singapore, China, and the British Virgin Islands, and that she allegedly helped move around $7.5 billion worth of AI GPU imports. $2 billion was routed from Megaspeed to Speedmatrix, its Malaysia subsidiary, while another $4.6 billion moved directly from the Singaporean company into Shanghai Century Litong, a China-based cloud services company. It has also reportedly bought Nvidia GPUs from other sources, resulting in the estimated total value of its imports.People close to her also said that she would leverage her relationship with Jensen to customers, often posting pictures with him on her WeChat account, showing potential clients unpublished photos with the Nvidia chief, and even boasting that he would take her to dinner and give her gifts on her birthday. It also seems that Alice Huang was not acting alone. Multiple sources say that Kang Wei, Alice Huang’s husband, was central to the operation to acquire AI GPUs. He even seemingly acknowledged her relationship with Jensen Huang and has jokingly said that she was a personal assistant to the billionaire.However, it seems that the straw that broke the camel’s back was another allegation that Jensen had an affair with another woman — this time, with Kimberly Powell, the company’s vice president of health care who directly reported to him. Hours after this revelation, the company board announced that Jensen had resigned from all his leadership positions at Nvidia, with employees saying he looked “broken and shattered” as he left the company he spent over three decades building in disgrace. Nvidia is looking for internal and external CEO candidates. Chief financial officer Colette Kress is serving as interim chief executive.Huang resurfacesIt may be the end of an era, but this does not necessarily spell the end for Jensen Huang. Despite his sudden downfall and quick removal from Nvidia, his status as the king of AI infrastructure remains valuable to the AI industry. Elon Musk even said on X that it “would be an honor” to hire him, and this could ring true for any business that wants to break into the semiconductor space. But does he even want to return?Huang's first public statement after his resignation came on X on Nov. 17, in which the former CEO said he has "outpouring of calls from Nvidia’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO," and that if asked by the company's board, he would be "honored" to take the job."Over 190,000 shareholders, partners, current and former employees, and fans, including Elon Musk and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, have signed an online petition to bring him back as the leader of the company. President Donald Trump called for his reinstatement as Nvidia CEO.The board, however, may not see things the same way. Multiple reports suggest that the board isn't considering bringing Huang back, and instead is focusing on a new candidate, the ongoing investigation into Huang, and preparing for national security history.titleZh: 黄仁勋的陨落——一系列指控与丑闻的时间线，这些指控与丑闻击垮了AI基础设施之王
history.descriptionZh:
黄仁勋于1993年与Chris Malachowsky和Curtis Priem在硅谷一家Denny's餐厅共同创立了Nvidia。这家最初以游戏硬件为主业、曾以“公司距破产永远只有30天”为非官方座右铭的小公司，在30余年间成长为全球市值最高的企业。黄仁勋作为联合创始人兼首席执行官，是这一崛起的核心人物。他最具前瞻性的决策之一是在约20年前就开始布局CUDA计算平台，远早于ChatGPT让AI走向大众普及。此外，Nvidia通过收购多家企业，将AI GPU部署规模扩展至数十万级别。2022年ChatGPT发布后，AI竞赛全面爆发，科技巨头与AI初创公司争相抢购GPU，Nvidia在OpenAI大语言模型发布后不到一年内市值突破万亿美元。作为公司最大个人股东，黄仁勋与妻子Lori跻身全球最富有者之列。

黄仁勋个人风格鲜明，常在LinkedIn上标注自己曾在Denny's做过洗碗工、杂工和服务员，也被看到在越南吃街头小吃、在韩国光顾炸鸡店，甚至带着35位台湾半导体企业CEO在台北聚餐。但与此同时，作为AI行业最重要的芯片公司掌舵人，他在商业与治理领域的影响力也与日俱增，业界领袖注意到Nvidia对希望获得GPU训练AI模型者的支配力，有亿万富翁在晚宴上向他恳求供货。特朗普第二任期开始数周后，黄仁勋便在白宫与他会面，讨论AI政策与硬件出口管制。

中美科技竞争已持续多年，华为等中国企业因与解放军有关联而被列入黑名单。2022年8月，即ChatGPT让AI家喻户晓前约三个月，华盛顿扩大对华贸易禁令，对Nvidia的H100和A100 GPU实施出口管制。Nvidia随后专门为中国市场打造了符合美方标准的数据中心GPU——A800，于当年11月推出。尽管其性能仅为其基础型号A100的70%，但据报道仍在中国客户中需求旺盛。然而A800的生命周期较短，2023年10月拜登政府再次提高性能门槛，导致A800和H800 GPU被禁止对华出口。这迫使公司再次迭代，推出可对华销售的新型号Nvidia H20，于2024年初上市。但在拜登任期结束前的2025年1月，美方又提出更严格的“AI扩散政策”，按信任与风险等级将各国分档：第一档包括美国及其最亲密盟友，限制极少；第三档则实质上被禁止获得含美国技术的先进AI GPU。这对Nvidia构成严重问题，因为中国是全球第二大计算机市场，占其数据中心销售额的20%至25%。公司游说美国政府放宽AI GPU出口限制，据报道黄仁勋在2025年4月初花费100万美元与特朗普共进晚餐后，特朗普曾暂停拟议的H20禁令，但白宫不到一周后仍禁止了该AI GPU的销售，导致公司减记55亿美元。黄仁勋本人对华盛顿的贸易禁令曾发表严厉评论，称“出口管制是一场失败”，使公司在中国AI GPU市场份额从95%降至零，并认为“让出整个中国市场可能不太具有战略意义，我认为这已经基本适得其反”。但即便在争取解除H20芯片贸易禁令的同时，他仍持续赞扬特朗普的关税计划，称其“极具远见”。特朗普最终在三个月后撤销禁令，并于2025年12月批准Nvidia H200对华出口，但条件是Nvidia需支付25%的费用。更新的Blackwell和Vera Rubin芯片至少在纸面上仍不对中国企业开放。

关于中国企业违反华盛顿贸易禁令、将Nvidia AI GPU走私入境的指控自2023年6月起流传。当时路透社披露深圳卖家在被私下询问时可获得A100芯片，据称这些芯片来自公开市场出售的剩余库存，或通过印度、台湾和新加坡的中间商购入。2024年1月另一篇报道称，中国军方及相关机构、国有数据中心乃至高校仍在购买被禁的A100和H100芯片。六个月后，关于专门通过其他国家走私AI GPU乃至整台服务器的地下网络的报道开始出现。2025年一份调查报告显示，至少有价值10亿美元的Nvidia AI芯片被指流入中国。有卖家将非法AI GPU交易比作海鲜市场，经纪商和零售商在网上公开叫卖最先进的Nvidia AI芯片，从RTX 5090 GPU到完整的B200服务器。尽管有这些报道，黄仁勋持续否认Nvidia芯片被走私至中国。他在Computex 2025上对记者表示：“没有任何证据表明存在AI芯片转移。”他还补充说：“Grace Blackwell系统重近两吨，你不可能很快把它装进口袋或背包里。因此这些系统相当容易追踪……但重要的是，我们销售给的国家和公司都认识到转移是不被允许的，大家都希望继续购买Nvidia技术，因此他们会非常仔细地自我监控，对此相当谨慎。”在这些AI芯片走私传言甚嚣尘上之际，负责执行美国贸易制裁的工业与安全局被认定“能力不足”且资金短缺，一直依赖过时的人工流程来执行对中国科技公司的限制。尽管如此，世界各地仍有公司和个人因绕过华盛顿出口管制而被调查和逮捕。新加坡当局在2025年初捣毁了一个为中国AI实验室DeepSeek走私Nvidia GPU的团伙，突袭22个地点并逮捕9人。同年10月，一家由Alice Huang领导的新加坡公司Megaspeed被指转移了价值20亿美元的Nvidia芯片。次月，四名美国人因向中国运送400块Nvidia A100并试图再发送50块Nvidia H200 GPU而被捕。约四个月后，一起更大的走私丑闻曝光：三名Super Micro员工因向中国走私价值25亿美元的Nvidia硬件被捕，嫌疑人包括公司联合创始人Yih-Shyan“Wally”Liaw，但Super Micro本身未被牵连。该案遍及全球，台湾当局于2026年5月突袭12个相关地点，6月又调查9个地点和6人。黄仁勋在逮捕和突袭后敦促该公司整改出口管制合规，对媒体表示：“我们坚持合作伙伴必须合规。我们希望他们加强和改进监管合规，防止此类事件再次发生。”但就在他发表该声明仅五个月后，一项惊人的指控让一切崩塌。

2026年10月29日，《纽约时报》报道称，黄仁勋可能通过一位与他“关系密切”的公司高管——Alice Huang——成为中国间谍行动的目标。Nvidia否认该指控，公司发言人对Tom's Hardware表示：“Megaspeed与许多其他区域云客户并无不同。黄仁勋与Huang女士的互动并不异常或出人意料。与客户会面是CEO工作的一部分；黄仁勋每年与数千名客户高管交谈。我们的区域云客户收到的是普通商业信息——并非敏感的Nvidia商业秘密——以及零国家安全相关信息。”但仅过了一周多，美国情报来源称这位前Nvidia掌门人与Megaspeed高管有婚外情。Megaspeed正是被指控走私价值20亿美元Nvidia芯片的公司。到11月8日周日晚，黄仁勋承认了这段婚外情，但未在声明中点明第三方身份。许多政府官员通常会对科技高管的私人生活睁一只眼闭一只眼，但他是美国首屈一指的AI芯片制造商领导人，且与总统关系密切，这引起了当局注意。美国国会要求他参加闭门会议，讨论Nvidia“针对外国对手间谍活动的安全协议”，FBI也调查了他与该疑似中国间谍的关系。承认与指控引发人们对Alice Huang的深入挖掘。《The Information》的调查显示，她与一个横跨新加坡、中国和英属维尔京群岛的“迷宫”般公司网络有关，据称她帮助转移了约75亿美元的AI GPU进口。其中20亿美元从Megaspeed流向其马来西亚子公司Speedmatrix，另有46亿美元直接从这家新加坡公司流入中国云服务公司上海世纪利通。据报道，她还从其他渠道购买Nvidia GPU，使其进口总值达到估算水平。接近她的人士称，她会利用与黄仁勋的关系招揽客户，经常在微信账号上发布与他的合影，向潜在客户展示与这位Nvidia掌门人的未公开照片，甚至夸口说他会带她共进晚餐并在她生日时送礼物。Alice Huang似乎并非单独行动。多名消息人士称，她的丈夫Kang Wei是获取AI GPU行动的核心人物。他甚至似乎认可她与黄仁勋的关系，并曾开玩笑说她是这位亿万富翁的私人助理。然而，压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草似乎是另一项指控：黄仁勋与另一名女性——公司直接向他汇报的医疗健康副总裁Kimberly Powell——有婚外情。这一消息曝光数小时后，公司董事会宣布黄仁勋辞去Nvidia所有领导职务，员工称他离开这家他花费30多年打造的公司时看起来“破碎而崩溃”。Nvidia正在寻找内部和外部CEO人选，首席财务官Colette Kress担任临时首席执行官。

这可能是一个时代的终结，但未必是黄仁勋的终结。尽管他突然倒台并被迅速逐出Nvidia，他作为AI基础设施之王的地位对AI行业仍有价值。埃隆·马斯克甚至在X上表示，雇用他“将是一种荣幸”，这对任何想进入半导体领域的企业都可能成立。但他是否还想回归？黄仁勋辞职后首次公开声明于11月17日发布在X上，这位前CEO表示“Nvidia员工、投资者、商业伙伴和客户纷纷打电话给我，要求我回归CEO职位”，如果公司董事会要求，他将“荣幸”地接受这份工作。超过19万名股东、合作伙伴、现任和前任员工及粉丝，包括马斯克和Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney，签署了一份在线请愿书，要求让他重新领导公司。美国总统特朗普呼吁恢复他的Nvidia CEO职位。然而董事会可能不这么看。多篇报道称，董事会并未考虑让黄仁勋回归，而是专注于新候选人、对黄仁勋的持续调查以及为国家安全调查做准备。相关事件还包括：Nvidia诞生地Denny's卡座纪念牌在丑闻后被移除（后已恢复），上面标记着“开启万亿美元公司的卡座”；马斯克签署请愿书要求恢复黄仁勋职位，超过13万人签名，但并非所有Nvidia员工都支持他回归；特朗普呼吁恢复黄仁勋Nvidia CEO职位，但据报道董事会因正在进行的国家安全调查而拒绝恢复这位失势CEO；有报道称黄仁勋可能在谋划回归，其盟友在辞职丑闻后数日内成立“作战室”推动复职；据报道黄仁勋在辞职会议上“破碎崩溃”地屈服，数千名员工在内部论坛集会呼吁复职；上海基金经理Kang Wei将妻子Alice Huang介绍给黄仁勋，并构建了75亿美元的Nvidia AI GPU走私网络，这位情妇的丈夫开玩笑说她是Nvidia CEO的“私人助理”；Nvidia CEO黄仁勋因多段婚外情及中国间谍指控辞职，Colette Kress被任命为临时CEO，董事会正在寻找永久替代者；黄仁勋被指控与直接向他汇报的Nvidia高管有婚外情并试图掩盖；马斯克称雇用被逐Nvidia CEO黄仁勋“将是一种荣幸”，可能项目包括SpaceX计划中的GPU制造、Terafab或特斯拉AI加速器；国会可能向黄仁勋发出传票，若他未在当日回应“联合闭门简报”请求，美国众议员希望讨论公司“针对外国对手间谍活动的安全协议”；据报道Alice Huang在与黄仁勋三年关系期间帮助确保了超过75亿美元Nvidia AI GPU进口，帮助约24万块被禁芯片流入中国，主要是H100和H200；特朗普称FBI正在调查黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍的婚外情，Nvidia也被指控干预Megaspeed芯片走私调查；黄仁勋承认与疑似中国间谍有婚外情，在致员工信中道歉，公司董事会成立独立委员会调查；美国情报界认为黄仁勋在“蜜罐”行动中与一名中国间谍有婚外情，该间谍嫌疑人与一家被控走私20亿美元AI芯片的公司有关；Nvidia成为全球市值最高公司，年内第二次超越苹果；报道称黄仁勋可能通过一名“中国情报资产”成为中国间谍行动目标，该高管所在公司因向中国走私被禁AI芯片正接受调查，她被指为间谍并向北京提供信息；台湾突袭Super Micro及两家供应链合作伙伴，扩大Nvidia走私调查，调查9个地点并传唤6人；在25亿美元Super Micro走私案破获后，黄仁勋敦促该公司整改出口管制合规，台湾也开始打击对华AI GPU芯片走私；台湾首次正式打击Nvidia AI芯片走私，突袭12个地点，追捕三名涉嫌伪造文件和虚假申报的逃犯；黄仁勋称Nvidia在中国市场份额现为“零”，称美国出口政策“已基本适得其反”；Super Micro员工被控向中国走私价值25亿美元Nvidia硬件，涉案者用吹风机在真实硬件和数千台假服务器之间转移序列号；特朗普批准Nvidia H200对华出口，附加25%费用，报道称企业须遵守北京严格规定才能进口外国芯片，AMD和英特尔将从政策转变中受益；四名美国人被控向中国走私Nvidia history.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Compact Desktops Out Now
history.description: New NVIDIA RTX Spark compact desktops from ASUS, Dell and MSI are available today, bringing local AI agents, image and video generation, and model fine-tuning to a dedicated Windows PC. With up to 128GB of unified memory and NVIDIA’s AI software stack, these systems provide room for larger local models alongside RTX-accelerated creative and development […]
history.content: New NVIDIA RTX Spark compact desktops from ASUS, Dell and MSI are available today, bringing local AI agents, image and video generation, and model fine-tuning to a dedicated Windows PC. With up to 128GB of unified memory and NVIDIA’s AI software stack, these systems provide room for larger local models alongside RTX-accelerated creative and development tools. A dedicated desktop can keep agents and scheduled tasks running while a laptop travels or handles other work. Alongside the new desktops, an expanding software ecosystem brings more creative and development workflows to RTX Spark laptops and compact desktops. Native Windows on Arm applications from Adobe, the NVIDIA DLSS Ray Reconstruction feature in Blender and local generation workflows in ComfyUI expand what creators and developers can do on RTX Spark — all on one Windows PC. A Windows PC Built for Local AI As workflows expand to include local AI models and agents, more work can continue beyond an active editing session — from generating assets to processing long renders or scheduled tasks. RTX Spark compact desktops give developers, creators and AI enthusiasts a dedicated Windows PC for local models and always-on agents. They bring together image and video generation, model fine-tuning, creative applications and development tools in one compact system. Running supported models locally keeps locally processed code and files on the PC and avoids per-token cloud application programming interface (API) charges for those tasks. RTX Spark compact desktops like the ASUS ProArt GR1X mini PC are built to run personal AI agents 24/7. RTX Spark desktops are equipped with a 20-core NVIDIA Grace CPU, an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU with 6,144 CUDA cores and up to 128GB of unified memory, delivering up to 1 petaflop of AI performance. Ten-gigabit Ethernet connectivity enables fast transfers of large datasets, model files and creative assets between RTX Spark compact desktops and networked storage. This advanced hardware unlocks incredible capabilities for creators, developers and AI enthusiasts, including: Running massive 120-billion-parameter large language models locally Rendering 90GB+ 3D scenes in real time Smoothly editing 4:2:2 video in real time The MSI EdgeMesa N AI+ Series RTX Spark compact desktop. New compact desktops are available for purchase from ASUS, Dell and MSI, joining the RTX Spark family of laptops available today. Mini PCs from Acer, GIGABYTE and HP are coming soon, along with the Microsoft Surface RTX Spark Dev Box. From Local Agents to AI Creation Native CUDA support and Linux development tools through Windows Subsystem for Linux give developers a foundation for building and running local AI workflows. Developers can set up agents with Hermes Agent or NVIDIA NemoClaw blueprints and fine-tune supported models using Unsloth. RTX Spark can run creative agents that connect familiar applications and local AI tools, helping creators move from an idea to finished work with natural-language instructions. NVIDIA Switchyard, now available in Hermes, automatically routes agent tasks between local and cloud models. Everyday tasks can run on device, while advanced reasoning draws on cloud models, helping manage cloud costs across creative workflows. These capabilities come together in creative workflows that connect Photoshop and ComfyUI through Hermes Agent. Using natural-language instructions, creators can turn sketches into rendered images and animations, or animate an image entirely on device — from isolating a subject and defining its motion to generating the finished video. NVIDIA brought these workflows to life at Adobe MAX, where attendees used natural-language instructions to turn sketches into rendered images and animations for a shared digital Miami landscape. The RTX Video Frame Generation and RTX Video HDR features, already available in ComfyUI, extend the pipeline: a generated clip can be expanded to 60 frames per second and converted to high dynamic range for color grading, all within a single ComfyUI workflow on RTX Spark. Adobe Accelerates the Full Creative Stack for RTX Spark NVIDIA and Adobe are expanding native Windows on Arm support and RTX acceleration across Adobe’s creative applications, helping video editors, photographers, designers and 3D artists work more efficiently on RTX Spark. Adobe Premiere accelerates a range of AI-powered editing features through NVIDIA TensorRT-RTX, including Enhance Speech, Object Mask, Scene Edit Detection and Auto Reframe — so editors spend less time waiting and more time cutting. GPU acceleration also extends to Film Impact transition and effects plug-ins. The update improves support for professional video formats, including Canon RAW, Red RAW, ARRI RAW, ARRICORE, ARRI HDE, H.264 and HEVC in MXF, ProRes RAW and long-GOP video. This lets editors realize more than 50% quicker turnaround on everyday H.264 video deliverables. Adobe Photoshop adds TensorRT-RTX acceleration for the Remove Tool and ArmRTX Spark-native Camera Raw support, helping photographers remove unwanted objects faster and work with RAW images without relying on emulation. At Adobe MAX, Adobe previewed a next-generation image processing engine with extensive GPU acceleration, including interactive Gaussian blur and Light Leaks filters. Adobe Substance 3D Painter 12.2 is now optimized for RTX Spark with native support on Arm for the first time in public beta. Artists in games, visual effects and visualization can run Substance Painter natively on RTX Spark laptops and compact desktops, with no compatibility layer required. Adobe Illustrator and InDesign now offer native Windows on Arm versions optimized for RTX Spark. Adobe Illustrator delivers up to 30% higher performance than its emulated version, helping accelerate illustration, graphic design and page-layout workflows on RTX Spark. Blender 5.3 Adds DLSS Ray Reconstruction to the Viewport Blender 5.3 integrates DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction into the Cycles viewport, helping artists evaluate lighting and materials with near-final-quality ray-traced previews as they work. The practical difference is immediate: instead of navigating a noisy, resolving preview, Ray Reconstruction delivers near-final-quality lighting, reflections and materials in the interactive viewport in real time. DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction support requires Blender 5.3 and the latest NVIDIA Game Ready Driver or NVIDIA Studio Driver. Download the NVIDIA App to get automatic notifications when the latest drivers are available, optimize games and applications from a unified GPU control center, and discover the latest NVIDIA tools and software. Windows Server 2028 Coming to DGX Station for Windows Announced at Microsoft Ignite, Windows Server is evolving for organizations that need to run AI closer to their enterprise applications and data. Microsoft is expanding hardware choice through support for the latest AI silicon, helping customers take advantage of accelerated inference and increasingly capable models in their own environments. NVIDIA DGX Station for Windows platform powered by the GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Desktop Superchip is expanding to include support for Windows Server 2028. New accelerator platforms and the breadth of the Windows silicon ecosystem provide customers options at different capability levels and price points for advanced AI development, local inference, and agent workloads at scale. Windows ML Updates Give Developers More Options Also announced at Microsoft Ignite, developers can now bring any GGUF model from Hugging Face and run it within Windows ML using the llama.cpp backend. The DxCGC backend, now available as an experimental release, is an integration for game developers that compiles and runs machine learning models through DirectX 12, allowing them to execute AI workloads alongside graphics. Windows APIs let applications integrate platform-provided AI capabilities adding GPU support for AION Instruct and VSR. Developers can also build high-performance AI models for Windows ML using the command line interface. #ICYMI: The Latest NVIDIA Local AI Updates 🦙 llama.cpp v1.0.0 marks a major milestone for building local AI apps. The open source inference engine introduces API versioning updates, alongside expanded model support and CUDA optimizations for NVFP4 inference. Learn more. 🎉 Ricursive Intelligence introduced its first open model: Ripple-65B Preview. The full-stack AI lab builds self-improving systems by co-optimizing hardware, software and models. Ripple-65B Preview was trained on NVIDIA B300 GPUs, refined using NVIDIA Nemotron post-training datasets and runs locally on DGX Spark. Download the NVFP4 checkpoint from Hugging Face. 🤖 Runway’s Praxis-1 is a newly released 27-billion-parameter world action model that predicts video and actions together. Developers can run it locally on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, DGX Spark and DGX Station, and adapt it to their own robots, cameras and tasks with LoRA fine-tuning. Download the NVFP4 checkpoint from Hugging Face. 🛠️ NVIDIA TensorRT Edge-LLM helps run AI models locally on DGX Spark with just a few commands. Read the technical blog, which walks through downloading Nemotron-3.5 Lightning, setting up optimized inference, testing prompts and serving the model through a local OpenAI-compatible API. Subscribe to the NVIDIA Local AI newsletter. Follow NVIDIA RTX Spark on X, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook. See notice regarding software product information.

history.titleZh: NVIDIA RTX Spark紧凑型台式机现已上市
history.descriptionZh:
NVIDIA 宣布，华硕、戴尔和微星的新款 RTX Spark 紧凑型台式机即日起上市，定位为专门运行本地 AI 的 Windows PC。该类产品面向开发者、创作者和 AI 爱好者，可在本地运行 AI 智能体、图像与视频生成、模型微调，并让智能体和计划任务 24 小时常驻运行；与笔记本配合时，台式机可承担持续计算，笔记本则用于移动办公或其他任务。

硬件方面，RTX Spark 台式机搭载 20 核 NVIDIA Grace CPU、拥有 6,144 个 CUDA 核心的 NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU，以及最高 128GB 统一内存，AI 性能最高达 1 petaflop，并配备 10GbE 以太网，便于在本地与网络存储之间传输大型数据集、模型文件和创作素材。统一内存和 NVIDIA AI 软件栈使系统能够本地运行最高 1200 亿参数的大语言模型、实时渲染 90GB 以上的 3D 场景，并流畅实时编辑 4:2:2 视频。华硕 ProArt GR1X 迷你主机等产品强调可全天候运行个人 AI 智能体；微星 EdgeMesa N AI+ 系列也在首批产品之列。宏碁、技嘉、惠普的迷你主机以及微软 Surface RTX Spark Dev Box 将后续推出。

软件生态同步扩展。RTX Spark 笔记本和紧凑台式机获得更多创作与开发工作流支持：Adobe 推出原生 Windows on Arm 应用，Blender 集成 DLSS Ray Reconstruction，ComfyUI 支持本地生成流程。开发者可通过原生 CUDA、Windows Subsystem for Linux 中的 Linux 开发工具、Hermes Agent 或 NVIDIA NemoClaw 蓝图构建本地智能体，并使用 Unsloth 微调模型。NVIDIA Switchyard 已集成到 Hermes，可在本地与云端模型之间自动路由任务：日常任务在设备端运行，复杂推理调用云端模型，以控制云成本。创作者还可通过 Hermes Agent 连接 Photoshop 与 ComfyUI，用自然语言把草图转为渲染图像或动画，并在设备端完成主体分离、运动定义和视频生成。ComfyUI 中已有的 RTX Video Frame Generation 和 RTX Video HDR 可将生成片段扩展到 60fps 并转为 HDR，用于调色。

Adobe 方面，NVIDIA 与 Adobe 正扩大原生 Windows on Arm 支持和 RTX 加速。Premiere 通过 NVIDIA TensorRT-RTX 加速 Enhance Speech、Object Mask、Scene Edit Detection、Auto Reframe 等 AI 功能，并改进对 Canon RAW、Red RAW、ARRI RAW、ARRICORE、ARRI HDE、MXF 中的 H.264/HEVC、ProRes RAW 和长 GOP 视频等专业格式的支持，使日常 H.264 视频交付周转时间提升 50% 以上。Photoshop 为 Remove Tool 增加 TensorRT-RTX 加速，并加入 Arm 原生 Camera Raw 支持。Substance 3D Painter 12.2 首次以公开测试形式原生支持 Arm，可在 RTX Spark 上无需兼容层运行。Illustrator 和 InDesign 也推出原生 Windows on Arm 版本，其中 Illustrator 性能较仿真版本最高提升 30%。Blender 5.3 将 DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction 引入 Cycles 视口，让艺术家在交互预览中实时获得接近最终质量的灯光、反射和材质效果，减少噪点预览等待；该功能需要 Blender 5.3 及最新 NVIDIA Game Ready 或 Studio 驱动。

在企业与开发者平台方面，微软 Ignite 宣布 Windows Server 2028 将支持 NVIDIA DGX Station for Windows，该平台基于 GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Desktop Superchip，面向在企业应用和数据附近运行 AI 的需求，并扩展加速推理和本地智能体工作负载的硬件选择。Windows ML 更新允许开发者从 Hugging Face 引入任意 GGUF 模型，并通过 llama.cpp 后端在 Windows ML 中运行；实验性的 DxCGC 后端可通过 DirectX 12 编译和运行机器学习模型，使游戏开发者能在图形负载旁执行 AI 工作负载。Windows API 还为 AION Instruct 和 VSR 增加 GPU 支持，开发者可用命令行界面为 Windows ML 构建高性能 AI 模型。

此外，NVIDIA 汇总了本地 AI 生态的最新进展：llama.cpp v1.0.0 发布，带来 API 版本管理、扩展模型支持以及面向 NVFP4 推理的 CUDA 优化；Ricursive Intelligence 推出首个开放模型 Ripple-65B Preview，基于 NVIDIA B300 GPU 训练、使用 Nemotron 后训练数据集，并可在 DGX Spark 本地运行；Runway 发布 270 亿参数的世界动作模型 Praxis-1，可同时预测视频和动作，支持在 GeForce RTX 5090、RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell、DGX Spark 和 DGX Station 上本地运行，并可通过 LoRA 微调适配不同机器人、摄像头和任务；NVIDIA TensorRT Edge-LLM 可通过少量命令在 DGX Spark 上本地运行 AI 模型，并提供下载 Nemotron-3.5 Lightning、优化推理、测试提示词及通过本地 OpenAI 兼容 API 提供服务的教程。整体来看，RTX Spark 通过“统一内存硬件 + 本地 AI 软件栈 + 原生 Arm 应用 + 云端协同路由”，把本地大模型、智能体、创作生成和开发工作流整合到一台 Windows PC 上，强调数据留在本地、降低按 token 计费的云 API 成本，并扩展常驻 AI 与专业创作场景。

history.title: Nvidia board faction angling for Jensen Huang return as CEO, report claims
history.description: Despite Nvidia's board saying it has no intention of bringing former CEO Jensen Huang back to the company, some directors are reportedly still pushing for that to happen.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 26 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Even though Nvidia says that it does not plan to bring its former CEO Jensen Huang back to the company, that hasn't stopped some of its board members from continuing to lobby for his return. Following the news that some of Huang's allies have formed a "war room" to drive his reinstatement just days after his resignation, one Nvidia employee went so far as to warn that the company faces the possibility of an exodus of "irreplaceable talent" if Huang isn't reinstated. We've even seen U.S. President Trump argue for giving Huang his old job back, but the company said during its November 17 earnings call that wasn't in the cards. Now, Semafor reports that some Nvidia board members aren't taking "no" for an answer.Huang, for his part, has already said that he would be "honored" to return to the company that he resigned from in disgrace just a few days ago. At the time, he admitted to having an affair with a woman who worked for Megaspeed, a controversial Nvidia customer linked to the smuggling of export-controlled AI hardware into China. That woman has also been accused of being a Chinese spy, further complicating an already troublesome matter for Nvidia and Huang. Huang and Nvidia's top lawyer will make an appearance before the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence, and China Select Committees in early December and are likely to face some difficult questions.But despite all of this, Huang is said to have spoken with at least one Nvidia board member about the possibility of making a return to Nvidia. That meeting took place hours before Nvidia chairman Harvey Jones said on the company’s earnings call that Huang wasn't coming back. The board voted unanimously to accept his resignation, and won't be backtracking. It's reported that three board members don't agree with that stance, while others have already turned their attention to who will replace Huang long-term. Interim CEO Colette Kress is not being considered as a full-time replacement for Huang.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Instead, Arm CEO Rene Haas has appeared as a frontrunner for the top job, with the Nvidia board believed to have already made an approach. Marvell CEO Matt Murphy is also another name under consideration, but the ongoing calls for Huang to be brought back into the fold are thought to have put him off. Rene Haas has reportedly been considereIt isn't just some of Nvidia's board members who have rallied around Huang. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney have also chimed in, while a Taiwanese skyscraper was used to send messages of support to a man who has proven hugely popular in the country. history.titleZh: 英伟达董事会派系图谋让黄仁勋重返CEO职位，报道称
history.descriptionZh:
这则报道聚焦英伟达（Nvidia）前CEO Jensen Huang（黄仁勋）辞职后引发的人事与治理风波。尽管英伟达公开表示不计划让Huang回归，但部分董事会成员仍在继续游说其复职。Huang辞职后数日内，其盟友已成立“作战室”推动其重新上任；一名英伟达员工甚至警告，若Huang不复职，公司可能面临“不可替代人才”流失。美国总统特朗普也公开主张让Huang恢复原职，但英伟达在11月17日财报电话会上明确表示这不在计划之内。Semafor随后报道称，一些董事会成员并不接受这一“不”的答复。

Huang本人已表示，若能回到这家他不久前“蒙羞辞职”的公司，将感到“荣幸”。报道披露，他辞职的直接背景是承认与Megaspeed一名女员工有婚外情。Megaspeed是一家有争议的英伟达客户，被指与将受出口管制的AI硬件走私进入中国有关；该女子还被指控为中国间谍，使事件对英伟达和Huang而言更加复杂。Huang和英伟达首席律师将于12月初出席美国众议院外交事务委员会、情报委员会和中国特别委员会听证会，预计将面对尖锐质询。

尽管争议缠身，报道称Huang至少与一名英伟达董事会成员讨论过回归可能性，而这次会面发生在英伟达董事长Harvey Jones在财报电话会上表示Huang不会回来之前数小时。董事会曾一致投票接受其辞职，且不会逆转这一决定；但据报有三名董事不同意该立场，其他董事则已把注意力转向长期继任者。临时CEO Colette Kress不被考虑作为Huang的全职接替者。Arm CEO Rene Haas被视为头号热门人选，据信董事会已与其接触；Marvell CEO Matt Murphy也在考虑范围内，但外界持续呼吁Huang回归据称让他有所退缩。除部分董事外，SpaceX CEO Elon Musk和Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney也公开声援Huang，台湾一栋摩天大楼还被用来发送支持信息。

需要说明的是，原文并未涉及AI芯片的技术原理、创新点、性能参数或产品对比数据，因此无法从该报道中提炼相关技术细节。其核心影响集中在公司治理、领导层稳定性、出口合规与政府关系层面；对英伟达这类AI芯片企业而言，高管更迭争议和出口管制相关听证可能影响客户信心、人才保留及政策沟通。

history.content: Nvidia has stopped sending its advanced AI chips to China despite the approval it received from the White House to do so in December last year. The announcement was made by interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress during an earnings call on Tuesday, marking a notable shift for the company that, under former CEO Jensen Huang, fought for the right to ship its powerful Hopper architecture H200 chips to China.“Our guidance ⁠does not have any licensed Hopper data center products included, and we are no longer shipping ​licenced Hopper data center products to China,” Kress said. She did not explain why Nvidia was ceasing its H200 processor shipments or clarify whether Nvidia would pursue other business with China in the future.The pivot comes after Huang stepped down from his position as Nvidia CEO last week following reports of multiple extramarital affairs, one with a woman who was suspected by US intelligence to be a Chinese spy. Nvidia already faced difficulties around offloading the AI chips prior to this scandal, however. Concerns were raised about failings to properly vet Chinese companies that were approved to handle the H200 AI chips. Reuters also reported earlier this month that around 600,000 ⁠H200 chips ​were stuck in Hong Kong after Beijing withheld approval for large-scale imports, with China seeking to reduce its dependency on US technology.

history.titleZh: 英伟达不再向中国出售AI芯片
history.descriptionZh:
Nvidia已停止向中国发送其先进AI芯片，尽管该公司去年12月曾获得白宫批准。临时CEO Colette Kress在周二的财报电话会上宣布，公司业绩指引中不再包含任何获许可的Hopper数据中心产品，并且“不再向中国运送获许可的Hopper数据中心产品”。她没有解释停止H200处理器出货的原因，也未说明Nvidia未来是否会在中国开展其他业务。

这一转向的背景是，Nvidia前CEO黄仁勋曾积极争取向中国出口基于Hopper架构的H200芯片。原文称，黄仁勋上周辞去CEO职务，此前有报道称其涉及多起婚外情，其中一名女性被美国情报部门怀疑为中国间谍。不过，Nvidia在丑闻之前就已面临AI芯片出货难题：一方面，外界担忧公司未能充分审查获准处理H200的中国企业；另一方面，路透本月早些时候报道，约60万颗H200芯片因北京未批准大规模进口而滞留香港，中国正寻求降低对美国技术的依赖。

从技术定位看，H200属于Nvidia Hopper架构的高端数据中心AI加速器，是H100的内存升级版本，采用HBM3e高带宽内存，重点提升大模型训练和推理所需的内存容量与带宽，并延续Transformer Engine等面向生成式AI的能力。原文未披露具体性能参数；公开资料通常将H200描述为在H100基础上显著提升内存容量和带宽，因而更适合大语言模型、生成式AI、云计算数据中心和科学计算等场景。正因如此，H200成为美国出口管制和中国进口审批共同关注的敏感产品。

影响上看，即便美方发放许可，Nvidia对华高端AI芯片供应仍受中方进口审批、合规审查和地缘政治因素制约。约60万颗H200滞留香港的数据，显示潜在渠道库存和中方审批瓶颈的规模。停止出货将限制Nvidia中国数据中心业务收入，也可能推动中国客户更多转向国产AI芯片或现有库存渠道，并加剧全球AI芯片供应链的分化。Kress未给出未来中国业务计划，后续走向将取决于许可范围、中方进口政策以及Nvidia替代产品的合规安排。

history.title: China threatens 'countermeasures' in the face of new AI GPU rental and export restrictions
history.description: China threatens "countermeasures" on the face of new Blackwell rental and export restrictions — Sino-American trade war may be renewed for a new season
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 8 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Yesterday, the Trump administration extended the reach of its existing export controls on high-end AI accelerator chips, namely, but not limited to, Nvidia's Blackwell lineup. The updated regulation now requires licenses for renting those chips in large quantities to the entirety of America's D:5 countries list (nations embargoed from arms sales). As expected, the news landed in Beijing like a lead dragon, and its Ministry of Commerce states that China "will take countermeasures to firmly safeguard national sovereignty, security, and development interests."Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc)While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply marketThe state of China's decade-long semiconductor pushHuawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fabChina's latest round of rare-earth export controls explainedThe bold move taken by the U.S. arrives at a peculiar time, as President Trump is currently visiting the nation for the APEC summit in Shenzhen. Trump is scheduled to meet President Xi Jinping on Thursday, Nov. 19, a tête-a-tête that's bound to be interesting. Both nations were recently embroiled in a bitter trade war, with ever-mounting tariffs and restrictions on both sides until a temporary truce was called in Oct. 2025. Only some restrictions were lifted, though; for example, Chinese semiconductors still face a 50% tariff when imported stateside.A potential restart of tariff-slapping would all but guarantee an even larger amount of turmoil in U.S. stock markets. Those seas are already choppy enough thanks to Nvidia ex-CEO Jensen Huang's romantic involvement with purported Chinese spy Alice Huang — along with mounting suspicions that the soulmates may have connived to siphon billions' worth of Blackwell chips from her Singaporean outfit Megaspeed onto Chinese AI laboratories.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Nvidia cut off about half of its Asian buyers last July, seemingly in the purview of the export controls, and told data center operators that over 50% of their business must come from non-Chinese companies. Meanwhile, both Malaysia and Singapore have intensified their scrutiny of AI hardware shipments.China's countermeasures ammo is as of yet unspecified. The nation had restricted the sale of gallium, germanium, and antimony to the U.S. previously, and the truce shelved that bullet until Nov. 2027. Beijing may well choose to simply not renew that agreement when that day comes. Although analysts believe that the nations will be cordial enough during this summit, Trump's perceived provocation may bring China's proverbial nuclear option of restricting rare earth exports back to the loading bay. You may like Investigative report details how export-restricted Nvidia AI chips reach China New US rules aim to restrict Chinese firms’ remote access to AI servers and infrastructure Nvidia cracks down on overseas cloud AI GPU rentals for China The truce on that particular matter only has a few weeks left, expiring on Jan. 10, 2027. Likewise, super-hard materials and high-density lithium batteries, crucial for the newest generations of EVs, solar power storage, and battery installations, all have white flags that will come down early next year. Analysts also expect that Chinese firms and their government will continue to heavily invest in domestic chip production, namely, but not only, by Huawei.Broadly speaking, the U.S.' updated chip control regulation means that Chinese firms cannot sidestep the existing control on chip sales by renting them instead, closing one of the main existing loopholes around the export restrictions. history.titleZh: 面对新的AI GPU租赁和出口限制，中国威胁采取“反制措施”
history.descriptionZh:
美国特朗普政府昨日进一步扩大高端AI加速器芯片出口管制的适用范围，覆盖英伟达Blackwell系列等产品，并将“大量租用”这类芯片纳入许可证要求，适用对象扩大至美国“D:5国家”武器禁运名单上的全部国家。所谓D:5名单包括中国、俄罗斯等被美国列入武器禁运的国家。新规的核心变化在于：过去管制主要针对芯片销售，中国企业理论上可通过境外云服务商租用算力绕过限制；现在，大规模租赁高端AI芯片同样需要许可证，等于堵住了“以租代购”的主要漏洞。同时，向印度尼西亚、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、巴西等国销售相关芯片也需申请许可证，因为美国商务部怀疑这些国家存在进口Blackwell转售中国的渠道。

这一政策出台的背景是中美芯片与贸易博弈持续升级。两国此前经历了一轮加征关税和出口限制的贸易战，直到2025年10月才达成临时休战，但只是部分限制被解除，中国半导体产品进入美国仍面临50%关税。原文称，特朗普正赴深圳出席APEC峰会，并计划于11月19日与中国领导人会晤；在这一敏感节点扩大芯片管制，被视为对华施压。中国商务部已回应称，将采取反制措施，坚定维护国家主权、安全和发展利益，但具体反制工具尚未公布。

从技术层面看，Blackwell是英伟达面向数据中心的新一代AI加速器平台，主要用于大模型训练和推理，依赖高算力GPU、高带宽内存和高速互连，是当前先进AI基础设施的核心部件。报道没有给出Blackwell具体算力、显存带宽等性能参数，因此无法进行芯片级性能对比；其重点在监管逻辑创新：美国不再只卡“芯片实物出口”，而是把“算力租赁”和“第三国转口”纳入管制链条，试图从云服务、分销渠道和区域转口三个环节限制中国获取先进AI算力。应用场景上，这类芯片主要服务AI数据中心、云计算平台、大模型训练与推理集群；管制收紧将直接影响中国AI实验室和云厂商获取先进算力，也会波及亚洲的数据中心运营商、云租赁商和硬件分销商。

原文还提到，英伟达曾在7月切断约一半亚洲买家的业务，并要求数据中心运营商保证超过50%的业务来自非中国公司；马来西亚和新加坡也在加强对AI硬件货运的审查。市场层面，若关税和出口限制重新升级，可能进一步加剧美国股市波动。原文还夹杂了关于英伟达亚洲分销渠道、新加坡Megaspeed涉嫌将Blackwell转售至中国AI实验室的疑虑，以及针对黄仁勋个人关系的未经证实指控，摘要对此不展开。中国可能的反制选项包括此前对镓、锗、锑实施的对美出口限制，该措施在休战框架下暂缓至2027年11月，北京可能到期不再续约；稀土出口管制被视为更强硬手段，超硬材料和高密度锂电池等关键物项的限制豁免也将在明年初到期。分析人士预计，无论外部管制如何变化，中国企业和政府仍会继续加大对本土芯片产业的投资，华为是重点之一。总体而言，新规将高端AI芯片的管制从“卖芯片”延伸到“租算力”和“第三国转口”，短期内加大中国获取先进AI算力的难度，也可能推动中国本土AI芯片和算力基础设施加速替代。
